# Ten languages

## rust

```rust
fn main() { println!("Hello"); }
```

## python

```python
def greet(name):
    return f"Hello {name}"
```

## javascript

```javascript
const greet = (name) => `Hello ${name}`;
```

## typescript

```typescript
const count: number = 42;
```

## json

```json
{"enabled": true, "count": 42}
```

## html

```html
<main><h1>Title</h1></main>
```

## css

```css
body { color: #1a1a1a; }
```

## bash

```bash
printf "%s\n" "hello"
```

## sql

```sql
SELECT name FROM users WHERE active = TRUE;
```

## go

```go
package main
func main() { println("Hello") }
```
